candidate.source_vertex_representative_displacemen: source representative displacement includes declared local reference-clearance repairs; not a surface Hausdorff bound

local_repair.method: symmetric displacement of one exact near-coincident nonincident source-vertex pair along its original separation vector; no faces deleted/added and no ancestry reassigned
local_repair.declared_inference: local reference-geometry repair to clear a solver numerical CCD roundoff band; not a measured anatomy correction

collective_clearance_repair.method: single-vertex local inferred reference-clearance offset, preserving every face and source-face ancestry; this composes with and retains the earlier pair repair
collective_clearance_repair.closest_feature: source candidate vertex 400 to edge (407,398) of candidate face 243
collective_clearance_repair.local_inference: increase a single source-registered fold clearance beyond the active contact thickness; not measured anatomical correction

world_space_local_repair.world_transform_order: normalized double quaternion -> double rotate -> double translation -> Float32 emission
